home.heading: Training and markets, open to apply
home.intro: The Municipality runs free training courses and rural markets for people who farm, keep livestock, or make and sell food. Anything open to apply for is listed here. You do not need an account.
home.count: {count, plural, =0 {Nothing open at the moment} one {# opportunity open} other {# opportunities open}}
home.emptyBody: There are no courses or markets taking applications today. New ones are added through the year — check back, or ask at the Municipality office.
home.loadFailed: The list could not be loaded. Check your connection and try again.
home.linkageCtaBody: Ask the Municipality to connect you with a buyer, a processor or a market.
home.mineCtaBody: Check what has happened with it.

typeHint.training: Learn a skill. Open to anyone.
typeHint.advisory: One-to-one advice. You need to have completed a training course first.
typeHint.exhibition: Sell what you produce at a municipal market. Open to anyone.

avail.places: {count, plural, one {# place left} other {# places left}}

detail.noDescription: The Municipality has not added a description for this yet.
detail.notFoundBody: It may have closed, filled up, or finished. Go back to see what is open now.
detail.applySoon: Applications open shortly. Ask at the Municipality office in the meantime.
detail.applyNotYetOpen: Applications for this open on {date}. Come back then — nothing is needed from you before that.

apply.heading: Apply
apply.identifyIntro: First, tell us who you are. We use your national ID to check whether you are already on file, so you are not entered twice.
apply.nationalIdHint: Nine digits, exactly as printed on your card.
apply.nationalIdAgainHint: Typing it a second time catches a slip. Pasting is turned off here on purpose.
apply.errNineDigits: A national ID is exactly nine digits.
apply.errNoMatch: The two numbers are different. Check both against your card.
apply.dateOfBirthHint: We use this to confirm it is really you.
apply.errNetwork: We could not reach the Municipality system. Check your connection and try again.
apply.isThisYouHint: If this is not your name, the number was mistyped. Go back and check it against your card.
apply.noRecordTitle: We have no record of this number
apply.takenPartBefore: Have you taken part in a Municipality training or market before?
apply.yesCheckNumber: Yes — let me check the number
apply.yesTryPhone: Yes — try my phone number instead
apply.noFirstTime: No, this is my first time
apply.phoneIntro: If you have taken part before but we have no date of birth for you, your phone number can confirm it instead.
apply.registerIntro: We will add you to the register. Please check your details before sending.
apply.fullNameHint: As written on your national ID card.
apply.privacyNote: The Municipality uses these details to run the programme and to report totals to the donor. Reports never name anyone.

applied.title: Application sent
applied.body: The Municipality will review it and contact you. Nothing is confirmed until they do.

already_applied.title: You have already applied
already_applied.body: We already have your application for this. There is no need to send another one.

cannot_verify.title: We could not confirm your details
cannot_verify.body: Check your national ID and date of birth against your card. If they are right and this keeps happening, please visit the Municipality office — we can sort it out there.

not_open.title: This is no longer open
not_open.body: It may have closed, filled, or been cancelled since you opened the page.

full.title: Every place is taken
full.body: This one is full. Other trainings and markets may still be open.

ineligible.title: A completed training comes first
ineligible.body: Market advice is for people who have finished a Municipality training. Apply for a training first — once you have completed one, this opens up.

withdrawn.title: Your earlier application was withdrawn
withdrawn.body: We received this application before, and it has since been withdrawn. Please contact the Municipality office — they can tell you why and what to do next.

apply.stallIntro: One more step. This helps the market team plan the stalls.
apply.producerType: What kind of producer are you?
apply.products: What do you make or sell?
apply.productsHint: Tap all that apply. You can leave this blank if you are not sure yet.
apply.alreadyKnown: We already have these details, so you will not be asked for them again.

linkage.heading: Ask to be connected to a buyer
linkage.intro: If you have finished a market advisory session with the Municipality, you can ask us to connect you with a buyer, a processor, a supplier or a market.
linkage.whoCanAsk: This is only for people who have completed a market advisory session. If you have not, speak to the Municipality about joining one first.
linkage.identifyIntro: First, tell us who you are so we can find your record.
linkage.noRecordWhy: You cannot register on this page. Market linkage is for people who have already completed a Municipality training and then a market advisory session, so everyone who can use it is already on our records. If you have taken part before, check the number or contact the Municipality.
linkage.detailsIntro: Now tell us what you produce and what you are looking for.
linkage.title: What you produce
linkage.titleHint: A short name for your work — for example, Umm Ali's home preserves.
linkage.activityTypeHint: Choose the one closest to what you do.
linkage.mainProductHint: Optional. For example, tomatoes, olive oil, jam.
linkage.requestHint: A buyer, a processor, someone to supply seed or feed, a place to sell. Say as much as you can — it helps us find the right partner.

requested.title: Your request has been sent
requested.body: The Municipality will look at it and get in touch. This may take some time — we look for a partner that fits what you produce, and that is not always quick.

already_requested.title: We already have this request
already_requested.body: This request reached us before, so we have not created a second one. There is nothing more for you to do.

cannot_verify.title: We could not confirm who you are
cannot_verify.body: The details you gave do not match a record we hold. Check the national ID number and the date of birth, or contact the Municipality.

ineligible.title: A market advisory session comes first
ineligible.body: Market linkage is for people who have completed a market advisory session with the Municipality. Our records do not show one for you. If you think this is wrong, contact the Municipality.

withdrawn.title: This request was withdrawn
withdrawn.body: We received this request before and the Municipality has since withdrawn it. Contact us before sending it again.

failed.title: Something went wrong
failed.body: Your request was not sent. This is a problem on our side, not with your details. Please try again.

mine.heading: My applications
mine.intro: Enter your national ID and date of birth to see everything you have applied for and what has happened with it.
mine.usePhone: I do not know my date of birth
mine.cannotVerifyBody: The details you gave do not match a record we hold. Check the national ID number and the date of birth, or contact the Municipality. We give the same answer whenever we cannot confirm who you are, so this page can never be used to find out whether a number is registered.
mine.emptyBody: We know who you are, and you have not applied for anything so far. Have a look at what is open.

preview.title: Previewing the public site
preview.note: Only you can see this bar. Visitors do not.
